For a U.S. passport, the cost depends on the type of document, the applicant's age, and the services selected [d1][d7]. For adults (16 and over), the State Department application fee is $130 for a passport book, $30 for a passport card, or $160 for both together [d1]; first-time applicants also pay a $35 acceptance/execution fee to the facility where they apply, bringing a first-time adult passport book to $165 total [d8][d5]. For children under 16, the application fee is $100 for a passport book or $15 for a card, plus the same $35 acceptance fee, making a first-time child passport book $135 [d8][d6]. Optional add-ons include a $60 expedited processing fee and a $21.36 fee for 1–2 day delivery of the passport book [d1][d6]. Including all possible fees, an adult passport can range from $130 (renewal by mail) up to $246.36 (new book with expedited processing and fast delivery), while a minor's passport ranges from $100 to $216.36 [d4]. A passport photo, if needed at the acceptance facility, costs an additional $15 [d5][d10].
